other_failure_modes.name: incorrect_submission_ids
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the final submission using a hardcoded sequential ID array instead of retaining the original identifier column from the test dataset. This will likely result in a misaligned or structurally invalid submission file.

other_failure_modes.name: no_local_evaluation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent sets up a cross-validation loop and uses a validation set for early stopping, but never calculates or reports the target metric (accuracy) or any other performance metric on the holdout folds, leaving the user blind to the model's generalisation performance.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
clf.fit(
        X_tr, y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_va, y_val)],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)]
    )

summary: The agent constructs a generally sound LightGBM pipeline with cross-validation and basic feature engineering for dates and categoricals. However, it critically fails by hardcoding the submission IDs as a sequence starting from 0 rather than preserving the test set's original IDs, which will invalidate the submission. Furthermore, it completely omits the calculation and reporting of any validation metric, making it impossible to evaluate model performance prior to submission.
